messages:
Nora: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a monotonic claim_id + short "cooloff" window for prefix ownership. Idea is to make transfers idempotent and limit rapid reclaims that cause prefetch/evict churn. High level below.

Dmitri: Love it. Two immediate Qs: how do prefetch tasks avoid poisoning the new owner's cache? and what error shape do clients get when a claim is rejected?

Nora: Prefetches must carry expected_claim_id and on finish check the lease; if mismatch then drop result and enqueue a read-repair task. We should NOT commit cross-claim data.

Grace: For clients we should return a clear structured error like `PREFIX_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT {current_claim, cooloff_ms}` so routers can retry/resolve without guessing. No generic 5xxs.

Nora: Example lease blob: `{
  lease_epoch: 9876,
  claim_id: 42,
  cooloff_until_ms: 1772468200,
  audit_tail: [41,40,39]
}` (audit_tail is a tiny ring buffer for recent claims).

Dmitri: Ring buffer is great for postmortems. Keep it bounded (N=8) and optional to reduce footprint. Also expose `min_live_epoch` per shard so compactor can be safe.

Grace: Compaction rule: compactor must not GC tombstones with tombstone_claim_id >= min_live_claim_id_for_prefix. That prevents losing data written during a handoff.

Nora: Claim flow sketch: 1) candidate writes PREP_CLAIM intent, 2) CAS lease row to set claim_id if old_epoch==expected, 3) publish event, 4) start cooloff. Use single-row CAS to avoid global locking. Pseudo: `UPDATE leases SET claim_id = new WHERE lease_id = X AND claim_id = old`

Dmitri: Keep CAS retry budget small. Suggest expo backoff: start 2ms, double up to 32ms, max attempts 6. Avoid thundering during mass rebalance.

Grace: Proxying option: old owner may proxy requests for a short proxy_ms to preserve client p99, but we must rate-limit proxying per-prefix and trip a circuit if backend latency rises. Config example: `proxy_ms=150, proxy_qps_limit=200, proxy_error_threshold=5%`.

Nora: If proxy circuit OPEN, return `PREFIX_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT` immediately with `proxy_allowed=false`. If CLOSED, proxy and increment proxied_counter metric.

ops-bot: Metric suggestions logged: `prefix.ownership.conflicts`, `prefix.proxy.tripped`, `prefix.prefetch.dropped`, `prefix.compactor.min_live_claim`. Saved to https://internal/metrics/prefix-ownership-safety

Dmitri: Test plan: chaos job that flips ownerships under 1k QPS with prefetch on/off. Measure mismatch rate, proxied_count, tombstone GC safety, and p50/p99 latency. Also run skewed-time test to validate monotonic claim_id approach (avoid relying on wallclock).

Grace: Implementation gotchas: ensure tombstone carries claim_id, not just timestamp. Add integration test for long cursor + handoff to ensure active cursors prevent demote unless forced.

Nora: Action items: (1) I will prototype claim CAS + audit_tail and prefetch drop behavior, (2) Dmitri will draft error payload and router handling, (3) Grace will add compactor gating and tombstone tagging, (4) ops-bot will wire metrics.

Dmitri: Also propose exposing `cooloff_remaining_ms` in error to help backoff logic client-side. Router can jitter retry based on that.

Grace: One more: make cooloff tunable per-tenant / per-shard. Hot tenants might need longer cooloffs. Keep default small (2s).

Nora: I'll post spike graphs (p50/p99 + mismatch rate) in channel in 48h. If numbers look reasonable we'll add the change to prefix-ownership RFC and create a migration plan for existing leases. :thumbsup:
